reason: I always get three quotes from local firms and go with the middle one, and a Kuwait company with no UK office and no reviews wouldn't even make my shortlist. Pay-when-happy sounds nice, but I'd be wondering where the catch is and who I'd chase if something broke after handover.
objection: No past clients, nobody local I can meet, and I don't know what 'happy' really means if we disagree on scope. It also makes me nervous that the domain and logins stay with them until I've paid.
would_change_my_mind: A couple of real Manchester businesses I can look up and message about their site, plus a written contract under UK law that says the domain is registered in my name from day one.
